newsitem.title: UK: UK to allow higher amusement arcade bingo prizes.
newsitem.headline: UK to allow higher amusement arcade bingo prizes.

text.p: The government plans to increase the maximum cash prize for amusement arcade bingo to five stg from 0.30 stg, Home Office minister Timothy Kirkhope said on Tuesday.
Speaking at the British Amusement Catering Trades convention in Birmingham, he said the increase could help amusement arcade bingo, which has fallen in popularity in recent years, to survive.
Kirkhope said the change could come into effect early in the new year.
